resources.string:
Tap a message to see the reaction bar - swipe it sideways. Your recent ones come first.
🌈 The shimmering “+” in the bar opens all emoji: smileys, gestures, hearts, animals, food, celebration - 400+ by section.
✖ removes your reactions. Even simpler: tap the reactions under a message and remove the one you don\'t want.
Double-tap a message for your last reaction.
Tap a message for the reaction bar. The shimmering “+” opens all emoji (400+), ✖ removes your reactions, and tapping the reactions under a message lets you remove or change them.
